main_text.p: cando Athanafio literas fcribit ad Con-ftantium, quibus ille territus Athanafium restituit.
Anno CCCLII. Liberius, init Pontifi-catum Romanum.
Anno CCCLV. In exilium mittitur Li-berius Arbitiano, & Lolliano Coff.
Anno CCCLVI. Gregorius Cappadox intruditur in fedem Alexandrinam, ærarij olim quæstor, & depeculator omnium, eoq; crimine profugus.
Anno CCCLXII. Necato Gregorio inuasore, e latebris emergens Athanasius redit Alexandriam sub Iuliano, & celeberrimo totius Ægypti conuentu excipitur.

Diftinxi tempora. Videamus modo, ana-liquid dixerit Allatius. Dixit ceffiffe Alexā-drinum Patriar. & verum dixit. Tu intelligis Athanasium, ideoque clamas, reclamasque Athanasium præter æquum, & bonum hæ-refeos deferri. Veruntamen Leoni, etiam si non diftinxerit tempora, non temere ex-cidit ceffiffe Alexandrinum. Cum rebus Ægypti turbatis, Ariani proterue, ac [illegible, ~12 letters] in Catholicos pessimis modis defæuirent, & potissimum Athanasij necem procurarent, in quo videbantur Catholicorum resfaluæ tutæque conseruari.

page.notes: Greek phrase after "ac" is not legible enough to read letter by letter; marked illegible. Right margin: fragments of marginal notes are cut off at the scan edge and could not be read; not transcribed. Printed "ceffiffe" and "pessimis" retained as the scan shows them.
